name: Digest Sequence
description: Simulates restriction enzyme digestion of a DNA sequence and returns the resulting fragments with their properties.
detailed_description: Simulates restriction enzyme digestion of a DNA sequence and returns the resulting fragments with their properties.
when_to_use: When you need digest sequence analysis

parameters.dna_sequence: [Required] Input DNA sequence to be digested (str)
parameters.enzyme_names: [Required] Names of restriction enzymes to use for digestion (List[str])
parameters.is_circular: [Optional] Whether the DNA sequence is circular (True) or linear (False) (default: True)
